item.title: Podman: A Modern Alternative to Docker
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Podman is a daemonless container engine focused on security and rootless operation. A look at the project’s history, architecture, differences from Docker, pods, Quadlet, and Podlet - and when it’s worth switching.

item.title: Docker vs Podman vs Kubernetes: A Detailed Comparison of Container Technologies
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Comparing Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes: architecture, security, overhead, and real-world use cases - from homelab to production clusters.

item.title: Quadlet and Podlet in Podman: How to Stop Writing Long podman run Commands and Run Containers under systemd
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: Quadlet is Podman’s declarative systemd unit format, and Podlet is a utility that generates those units from podman run and docker-compose.yml. A hands-on look at both tools, compared against Docker Compose.
